description: One variable of a prompt template: the placeholder the body spells as {{name}}, and the form the prompt library renders for it. The declaration is OPTIONAL — a template that declares no variables gets one derived variable per placeholder found in the body (its name as the label, required, a single line of text). When a template DOES declare them, the declared label, description, default, required flag, kind and options are what the reader sees, and a placeholder the declaration does not name stays literal text. A value is TEXT and is never evaluated: an empty field falls back to DefaultValue, and a required variable with neither makes the assembly invalid, so a prompt never reaches a host with a hole in it.
